description: the rigid fish of cfd_2d_6dof_fish (no deformation) started at 0.5 m/s (X 102) with the fluid-momentum coupling (X 198) and the symmetric forcing (X 14 2), free surge, heave and pitch: the first fit takes the velocity of the body (the fluid in the hull is not forced before the first stage; before, the body stopped in the first stage); the body symmetric about the centre of the grid keeps heave and pitch at round-off (X 14 1: 1e-4 rad/s after the first stages).
covers: sixdof_obj_cfd::momentum_fit_begin/end: the start from an initial velocity
